name: China Aircraft Leasing Group Holdings Limited
summary: China Aircraft Leasing Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides aircraft leasing services to airline companies in Mainland China and internationally. The company is involved in aircraft leasing, and purchase and leaseback; portfolio trading and asset management; fleet upgrade; and aircraft disassembly and component sales, as well as aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul activities. It also offers financing and management services. As of December 31, 2025, it had a fleet of 149 owned and 27 managed aircraft.
